items.caption: Solar System Kernels
items.description: Generic kernels for planets, satellites, and some asteroids, covering at least from 1950-01-01 to 2050-01-01, and including the latest generic text PCK and the mars_iau2000_v1.tpc PCK loaded in this order.

items.caption: Latest Leapseconds Kernel
items.description: Kernel set including only the latest generic LSK file (naif0012.tls).

items.caption: Latest Planetary Constants Kernel
